title: AREE Study Registration
description: Schema for a single registered public dataset (registry/studies/*.yaml).

study_id.description: Unique, stable identifier for this study within AREE. Must match the filename stem.

simulated.description: True if this study record uses synthetic/demo data rather than a real public dataset.

accessions.description: External identifiers. At least one should be present for non-simulated studies.

citation.description: Full citation string for the source publication/dataset.

species_identity.description: How the study animals were assigned to species. Required (by aree validate-study) for species whose vocabulary term has a `complex`, e.g. the hybridizing Mytilus edulis complex; optional otherwise.

basis.description: genotyped = species-diagnostic markers or sequence data on the study animals themselves; collection_site = inferred from where they were collected; authors_statement = the paper or deposit names the species with no stated basis; unstated = nothing recorded.

notes.description: Markers used, hybrid-zone context, or why the label is doubted.

strain_or_population.description: Strain, population, family, or breeding line where available.

assay_type.description: One or more assay type ontology term IDs (registry/controlled_vocabularies/assay_types.yaml).

analysis_mode.description: Whether AREE reanalyzes raw data or harmonizes already-processed results for this study.

comparisons.description: Each treatment-vs-control comparison reported by this study.

stressor_original.description: Free-text stressor/treatment description as reported by the source study.

resilience_classification.description: Must agree with the phenotype ontology's resilience_relevance unless explicitly overridden with a note.

contrast_type.description: What the two arms differ in, and under what conditions they were sampled. baseline_phenotype_difference: groups that differ in resilience by origin (line, family, population, ploidy, age), sampled under common unstressed conditions; the design for a predictive marker. phenotype_difference_under_exposure: groups that differ in resilience (by origin, outcome or prior conditioning), sampled during or after a challenge. exposure_response: treatment versus control, including conditioning treatments sampled before a later challenge. phenotype_by_exposure_interaction: the difference between two groups' responses to the same exposure (a 2 x 2 design). Evidence pools only within one contrast type. See docs/contrast_types.md.

sample_size.description: Number of samples analyzed in this comparison, after any excluded_samples are removed.

results_file.description: Relative path to the processed results file for this comparison, if analysis_mode is processed_results_harmonization.

excluded_samples.description: Samples deposited for this comparison's groups but left out of its analysis by curation. Each needs a reason and the evidence behind it; exclusions must rest on a measurement independent of the comparison's own result.

sample_id.description: sample_id as it appears in the study's sample sheet.

evidence.description: What was measured, and where the measurement is recorded.

meta_analysis_primary.description: Prespecified comparison for cross-study pooling, chosen within its contrast_type. When any comparison of a given contrast_type in a study sets this to true, meta-analysis pools only the flagged comparisons of that type from that study; the rest stay in the evidence table and on evidence cards. Comparisons of other contrast types are unaffected, because they never pool with this one. Choose it before examining results, and record the rationale in provenance.curation_notes.

exclude_from_meta_analysis.description: Keep this comparison out of every meta-analysis pool, whatever the study's other comparisons do. Use it for a contrast that should never pool, such as a field comparison confounded with genetics, site or husbandry. Unlike meta_analysis_primary, it lets a study keep all of its comparisons out of pooling. The comparison stays in the evidence table and on evidence cards and is counted in n_excluded_opted_out. Cannot be combined with meta_analysis_primary: true. Decide it before examining results.

reason.description: Why this comparison must not pool, in one sentence.
